department: Ph.D. Program in Earth and Environmental Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for Fall enrollment.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline: December 15 for fall enrollment

gre_general.value: The GRE is neither required nor considered for Earth and Environmental Sciences PhD admission.
gre_general.quote: Test Scores: The GRE is not required (or considered).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Earth and Environmental Sciences, and GRE scores are neither required nor considered.
gre_subject.quote: Test Scores: The GRE is not required (or considered).

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants should identify several prospective faculty members in their statement and are strongly encouraged to contact them while preparing their application.
supervisor.quote: Prior to assembling your application materials, be sure to identify several faculty members in the EES program who share your research interests and with whom you would be interested in taking courses. It is very helpful if you contact those faculty directly as you are assembling your application, to gauge their interest in your work.

funding.value: Every admitted applicant receives a five-year tuition fellowship, with additional five-year institutional funding packages available.
funding.quote: Every admitted applicant receives a five-year tuition fellowship, and a variety of additional five-year funding packages and other opportunities are available.

entry_route.value: Applicants with either a bachelor's degree or a master's degree are accepted on an equal footing.
entry_route.quote: We accept students with Bachelors degrees, as well as those with Masters degrees, with no priority placed on either group.
